name: Karnavati Finance Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1984, Karnavati Finance Ltd provides finance of personal loan, business 
loan, auto loan, education loan and mortgage loans[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
KFL is a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking NBFC, offering lending, financing, and wealth management solutions. Its services include personal and business loans, gold loans, LAP, microfinance, corporate finance, mortgages, project loans, structured finance, capital market lending, digital lending, and debt syndication.
Product Profile:
a) Personal Loan:[3]
The company offers unsecured loans which doesn’t require any security, mainly to Individuals and small businesses including proprietorship firms & MSMEs, etc
b) Business Loan:[4]
KFL provides finance for requirements of businessmen, Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME,) and entrepreneurs
c) Loan Against Property:[5]
This loan is provided to individuals and business enterprises against their property which requires property to be mortgaged in favor of KaFL for security purposes. The tenure of the loan is generally for 3 to 5 year
d) Gold Loan:[6]
Company also offers loans against gold, gold jewelry, etc.
e) Digital Lending:[7]
It provides loans through its digital interface
f) Micro Finance[8]

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -10.7% over past five years.
